top_choice_rationale: P002 certifies the discovery of a new class of quantum matter: the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction at a magic angle and the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, widely reproduced and tunable by one geometric knob. I weigh this above an excellent improvement of an existing capability. The citation is kept to what is secure and makes no claim about the pairing mechanism. The three-name cut leaves out parts of the experimental credit (Dean's hBN devices and other early groups), and eight years is acceptable maturity for the phenomena. P001 is a clean, mature and well-attributed second choice, and an award is preferable to none.
